signIn.title: Sign in to Kriraghor
signIn.subtitle: One account for kriraghor.com, esports and the app.
signIn.codeSent: We sent a code. It expires in 5 minutes.
signIn.newHere: New here? Verifying your number creates your account.
signIn.googleUnavailable: Google sign-in is not configured in this environment.
signIn.staffUseAdmin: Staff accounts sign in at the admin portal.

me.title: My account
me.ssoNote: This session is shared by every Kriraghor site.

admin.title: Staff sign-in
admin.subtitle: Kriraghor staff only. Two-factor authentication is required.
admin.totpSetupHelp: Add this key to Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or Authy, then enter the code it shows.

vendor.intro: Manage your grounds, shop, gym or tournaments. Desks arrive with their modules.

errors.network: Can't reach Kriraghor. Check your connection.

placeholder.soon: This section is built in a later phase.

notifications.title: Updates
notifications.signedOut: Sign in to see your updates.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.intro: Choose how we reach you for each kind of update.
prefs.locked: Required for your security and payments
prefs.notOffered: Not used for this kind of update
prefs.quietHoursHelp: Non-urgent texts and emails wait until morning.
prefs.languageHelp: Change it in your account settings.

home.title: Play for real prizes, every day
home.lead: Verified UIDs, fixed prize tables published before you pay, prizes paid to your bKash or Nagad.
home.noneOpenBody: Add your UID now so you are ready when the next one opens.
home.noRankingsYet: Rankings start after the first finished tournaments.

uid.title: Add your UID
uid.body: A screenshot of your in-game profile; our team verifies it.

register.title: Register and pay
register.body: bKash, Nagad or card. Your fee is held safely until the tournament ends.

checkin.title: Check in
checkin.body: Check in before the first match. The room ID and password appear shortly before the start.

play.title: Play and get paid
play.body: Results are posted with a dispute window; prizes land in your winnings.

esports.guaranteed: Prizes are guaranteed once the tournament runs, however many enter.
esports.tieBreak: Ties: most wins, then kills, then the latest match, then who registered first.
esports.standingsSoon: Standings appear after the first results.
esports.minNote: Cancelled with a full refund if fewer than {n} entries.

reg.title: Register
reg.waitlisted: You are on the waitlist. If a slot opens we will offer it to you; pay only then.
reg.needUid: You need a verified UID for this game
reg.needUidBody: Add your UID with a screenshot; it is usually verified within a few hours.
reg.needSquadBody: Create a squad or join one; {n} players with verified UIDs play.
reg.pick: Pick {n} players and up to {subs} substitutes
reg.refundNote: Full refund if you withdraw before registration closes or the tournament is cancelled.

me.title: UIDs and squads
me.lead: One UID per game. A UID can belong to one Kriraghor account only.
me.screenshotHint: JPEG or PNG showing your UID and name.
me.needAll: Choose a game and add a screenshot.
me.sent: Sent for review. We will tell you when it is verified.

squads.title: Squads
squads.needUid: Verify a UID to create a squad.
squads.name: Squad name

mine.empty: You have not entered a tournament yet
mine.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw? Your entry fee is refunded in full.
mine.withdrawForfeit: Withdraw? Registration has closed, so the entry fee is not refunded.
mine.roomSoon: The room ID and password appear here shortly before the match.

room.title: Room
room.notYet: The room opens shortly before the match. Keep this page open; it appears here.
room.updated: The room details changed. Use these.
room.rules: Version {version}. Do not share these; every view is recorded.

result.disputeSent: Dispute sent. Our team will review it.
result.disputeSentCase: Dispute sent. Your case number is {code}; follow it under My disputes on kriraghor.com.

win.title: Winnings
win.requested: Withdrawal requested. You will be told when it is sent.

lb.title: Leaderboards
lb.formula: Each finished tournament scores your placement percentile (100 for the winner) plus 2 per kill, times the tier weight. Older results fade with a {half}-day half-life. You need at least {min} tournaments to appear.
